trial_court: Court of Additional Principal Judge, Family Court, Gurugram (HMA-1240 of 2022)
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Parties solemnized marriage in 2009. Two children born out of wedlock. Petitioner lives with minor children and in-laws at Bhiwani. Respondent resides alone in Gurugram since 2020. Distance between residences is 150 km.

legal_principles.principle: While considering the transfer of a matrimonial dispute, the Court is to consider the family condition of the wife, the custody of the minor child, economic condition of the wife, her physical health and earning capacity of the husband.
legal_principles.held: the Courts have to take into consideration the economic soundness of both the parties, the social strata of the spouses and their behavioural pattern, their standard of life prior to the marriage and subsequent thereto and the circumstances of both the parties in eking out their livelihood

legal_principles.principle: In matrimonial matters, the Court is to give more weightage and consideration to the convenience of the female litigants.
legal_principles.held: the Courts are required to give more weightage and consideration to the convenience of the female litigants

legal_principles.principle: When two or more proceedings are pending in different Courts between the same parties which raise common question of fact and law, they should be tried together by the same Judge.
legal_principles.held: it is desirable that they should be tried together by the same Judge so as to avoid multiplicity in trial of the same issues and conflict of decisions

outcome.final_order: Petition for transfer of petition bearing No.HMA-1240 of 2022 filed by respondent-husband to a court of competent jurisdiction at Bhiwani allowed.
